Football league predictions for 33 competitions, updated daily. StatsUltra simulates every remaining fixture 15,000 times to predict each club’s chances of winning the league, qualifying for Europe or being relegated. The tightest title race right now is Germany’s 2. Bundesliga, where Hertha BSC and 1. FC Nürnberg are level on 39%, while Bayern München, Ferencváros and PSG are the clearest favourites elsewhere.

Updated 29 September 2026, 14:34 UTC, 15,000 simulated seasons per competition. Pick any league for the full table predictor, or simulate a season yourself on its page. Match data from FootyStats.
